tools.name: notion-search
tools.description: Searches Notion for content, or looks up a workspace user by name or email.

query_type.description: Use "user" to look up a workspace user; omit or use "internal" for content search.

teamspace_id.description: Restrict the search to one teamspace.

filters.description: Optional filters, e.g. teamspace_ids and title_only.

tools.name: notion-fetch
tools.description: Retrieves content from a Notion page, database, data source, or saved database view by its URL or ID.

tools.name: notion-create-pages
tools.description: Creates one or more Notion pages with specified properties and content.

pages.description: Pages to create, each with properties, content, icon and cover.

is_skill.description: Create the page as a Notion Skill.

creation_mode.description: Set to "draft" to create a draft.

allow_async.description: Allow the operation to complete asynchronously.

tools.name: notion-update-page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's properties, content, icon, or cover.

command.description: Update command such as update_content or replace_content.

replace_all_matches.description: Replace every match instead of one.

is_skill.description: Mark or unmark the page as a Skill.

allow_async.description: Allow the operation to complete asynchronously.

tools.name: notion-move-pages
tools.description: Move one or more Notion pages or databases to a new parent.

tools.name: notion-duplicate-page
tools.description: Duplicate a Notion page within your workspace. This action completes asynchronously.

tools.name: notion-create-database
tools.description: Creates a database with an initial data source and view.

tools.name: notion-update-data-source
tools.description: Updates a data source's properties, name, or description.

tools.name: notion-create-view
tools.description: Creates a database view with optional filters, sorts, and grouping.

tools.name: notion-update-view
tools.description: Changes a view's name, filters, sorts, or display settings.

tools.name: notion-create-folder
tools.description: Creates an empty folder under a parent page.

tools.name: notion-query-data-sources
tools.description: Query Notion data sources with SQL, read rows from one data source, or run a saved view.

mode.description: "rows" reads rows from one data source; "view" runs a saved view.

tools.name: notion-query-meeting-notes
tools.description: Queries the current user's meeting notes. Requires Business plan or higher with Notion AI.

tools.name: notion-create-comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a page or specific content, or reply to a discussion.

tools.name: notion-get-comments
tools.description: Lists all comments and discussions on a page.

tools.name: notion-get-users
tools.description: Lists workspace members and guests, searches users by name or email, or retrieves one user by ID or "self".

tools.name: notion-get-teams
tools.description: Lists the teamspaces in the workspace.

tools.name: notion-get-self
tools.description: Returns the connected workspace and the current user.

tools.name: notion-get-tool-access
tools.description: Reports which tools and parameters the workspace's plan allows.

tools.name: notion-create-file-upload
tools.description: Creates a short-lived upload URL for one local file (up to 20 MiB).

tools.name: notion-create-attachment
tools.description: Creates an attachment from inline text, a public HTTPS URL, or a completed upload.

source_file_id.description: ID of a completed file upload.

tools.name: notion-download-attachment
tools.description: Downloads the text content of an attachment (up to 200 KiB).

tools.name: notion-convert-page-to-skill
tools.description: Marks a page as a Notion Skill without changing its content.

tools.name: notion-download-skill
tools.description: Downloads a Notion Skill and its supporting files as a tar.gz archive.

tools.name: notion-get-async-task
tools.description: Checks the status of an asynchronous task such as a page duplication.

tools.name: notion-list-agents
tools.description: Lists available Notion Custom Agents.

tools.name: notion-search-agents
tools.description: Finds a Custom Agent's URL, which is needed to start a session.

tools.name: notion-query-sessions
tools.description: Lists Custom Agent sessions.

tools.name: notion-search-sessions
tools.description: Searches Custom Agent sessions.

tools.name: notion-spawn-session
tools.description: Starts a Custom Agent session.

tools.name: notion-get-session-status
tools.description: Gets the status of a Custom Agent session.

tools.name: notion-wait-session
tools.description: Waits for a session's current run to finish.

tools.name: notion-send-message-to-session
tools.description: Sends a follow-up message to a Custom Agent session.

tools.name: notion-stop-session
tools.description: Stops a session's run.

tools.name: notion-list-session-events
tools.description: Lists the events of a Custom Agent session.

tools.name: notion-read-session-event
tools.description: Reads one event of a Custom Agent session.
